BSE Share Price Drops After Bernstein Downgrade; MCX Rises

BSE's share price declined by 4% following a downgrade to 'Underperform' by Bernstein analysts. Concurrently, shares of MCX (Multi Commodity Exchange) saw a rise for the third consecutive day. Bernstein's report projected an 80% performance divergence between the two entities, rating one stock as 'Outperform'.
